preset.x265_crf23.desc: H.265 (CPU) · high quality · ~75% smaller, no GPU needed but slower
preset.x265_crf26.desc: H.265 (CPU) · good quality · ~85% smaller, smallest output but slowest

preset.nvenc_hevc_cq26.desc: H.265 (NVIDIA GPU) · good quality · smaller output, fast, needs an NVIDIA card

preset.nvenc_av1.desc: AV1 (NVIDIA GPU, RTX 40/50) · best compression, smallest output, fast
convert.mode.copy.desc: no recompression, lossless & fast, only changes the container

convert.mode.x265_crf26.desc: CPU encode · ~85% smaller, smallest output but slowest
convert.mode.nvenc_hevc.desc: NVIDIA GPU · high quality, fast, ~75% smaller
convert.mode.nvenc_h264.desc: NVIDIA GPU · best compatibility, fast, larger than H.265
convert.mode.nvenc_av1.desc: NVIDIA GPU (RTX 40/50) · best compression, smallest output

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Adjust the default mode, cloud connection and built-in labels; changes apply to the next run.
settings.key_note: The key stays on this device; logs, exports and errors are masked.
settings.key_unreadable: Key cannot be read; please enter it again
settings.model_none_hint: Pick from the endpoint list or enter an ID
settings.model_none_status: Choose a model to check image support
settings.model_detail_text: cannot be used for image recognition
settings.model_detail_error: network or endpoint error; you can retry
settings.model_detail_unknown: can be saved; testing image input is recommended
settings.model_note: Verification only checks whether the model accepts images, not recognition accuracy; each model is checked once. Testing is recommended; text-only models cannot be saved.
settings.reset_confirm: Only this page will be reset; saved settings are unchanged. Continue?
toolbar.ai_tip: Current mode: {mode}; click the arrow to change
guide.text: Recognition setup is not finished. Open settings any time from the gear.
status.hybrid_fallback: No custom labels — running local recognition this time
msg.cloud_key_missing: Cloud mode needs an API key — add one in Settings.
msg.cloud_key_unreadable: The saved API key cannot be read ({err}). Please enter it again in Settings.
msg.cloud_model_missing: Cloud mode has no model yet — choose one in Settings.
msg.cloud_text_model: The selected model is text-only and cannot read frames; pick an image-capable model.
mode.local.name: Local
mode.local.desc: All tagging happens on this machine; nothing is uploaded. Custom labels are unavailable.
mode.hybrid.name: Hybrid
mode.hybrid.desc: Local first; only frames that may match your labels are sent to the cloud.
mode.hybrid.target: Only frames that may match your custom labels are uploaded.
mode.cloud.name: Full cloud
mode.cloud.desc: Every sampled frame is uploaded; built-in and custom labels are tagged in the cloud.
mode.popover_need_labels: Hybrid needs at least one “My label”; without it, it falls back to Local.
mode.local.popover: Everything runs locally; custom labels are unavailable.
mode.hybrid.popover: Filter locally first; upload only possible matches.
mode.cloud.popover: Upload every sampled frame for a more complete result.
confirm.title: Start recognition
confirm.lead_cloud: All {frames} sampled frames will be uploaded.
confirm.lead_hybrid: Up to {frames} frames; only matches are uploaded.
confirm.add_custom_empty: + No custom labels yet — click to add
confirm.need_custom: Hybrid needs at least one “My label”. Add one, or switch to Local.
confirm.cloud_empty_note: You can continue without one; Cloud still uploads and tags every frame.
confirm.note: Switch to Local to upload nothing; you can cancel before starting.
confirm.note_hybrid: Nothing is uploaded without a match; Local stays fully offline.
first_run.title: Make recognition sharper
first_run.lede: Pick a mode and add the labels you care about. You can change everything later from the gear.
settings.mode_default_note: Applies immediately and becomes the default on the next launch
settings.current_mode_note: This session is using {mode}; you can change it before each run.
settings.local_api_note: Local mode needs no API key and never calls the cloud.
settings.local_custom_note: Local mode does not call the cloud; custom labels are unavailable.
settings.custom_note: An open-ended closed set: football, camping or a game name all work; leaving it empty is fine.
settings.tags_note: The technical group uses metadata and rules; it costs nothing in the cloud.
settings.frame_note_auto: Auto: 6 frames for short videos, 8 for long ones; balances speed and recall.
settings.frame_note_fast: Fast: 4 frames per video, good for quick batch filtering.
settings.frame_note_fine: Fine: 12–16 frames per video; more accurate but slower and costlier in the cloud.
settings.device_directml_note: Works with AMD, Intel and NVIDIA
settings.device_hint_gpu: Auto prefers the discrete GPU. AMD, Intel and NVIDIA all use DirectML, falling back to CPU when unavailable.
settings.device_hint_gpu_manual: GPU acceleration via DirectML. AMD, Intel and NVIDIA are supported, with CPU fallback.
settings.device_hint_igpu: Integrated GPU selected: it frees the CPU, but shared memory bandwidth limits the gain.
settings.device_hint_cpu: No DirectX 12 GPU detected; using the CPU.
settings.device_hint_cpu_manual: CPU selected manually; the GPU is not used.
settings.device_hint_no_dml: This install has no DirectML runtime; using the CPU.
settings.device_hint_warp: Only WARP software rendering was found; using CPU. Update the GPU driver to detect it again.
settings.device_hint_unavailable: Recognition falls back to CPU. Reopen Settings after updating the GPU driver.
settings.upload_only_hint: Hybrid only: upload frames that may match your labels; turning this off uploads more frames and costs more.
settings.upload_local_hint: Local mode recognises everything on this PC and uploads nothing.
settings.upload_cloud_hint: Cloud-only mode always uploads every sampled frame; this option does not apply.
settings.color_local_hint: Black/white cats, dogs and cars are sampled on this PC. Turning it off may drop or destabilize color tags.
settings.color_local_cloud_hint: Cloud-only mode does not sample colors locally. Switch back to Local or Hybrid to use it.
my_tags.title: My labels
my_tags.lede: Write down the scenes, activities or games you care about. Only Hybrid and Full cloud use them; an empty list is fine.
my_tags.hint: Enter or comma adds several at once; up to 10.
my_tags.empty_body: Add the scenes, activities or games you often record; leaving it empty is fine.
my_tags.note: Labels are sent verbatim and never merged; drag the handle to reorder.
my_tags.foot_note: Target vocabulary for Hybrid and Full cloud
settings.pane_mode_lede: The mode decides what the cloud can see.
settings.pane_api_lede: Hybrid and Full cloud share one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
settings.pane_tags_lede: My labels are a closed cloud set; built-in tags drive local filtering.
settings.pane_advanced_lede: Defaults suit most videos; change them for coarse batches or extra recall.
settings.scope_note_local: Everything runs here; no frames are uploaded.
settings.scope_note_hybrid: Only frames that may match My labels go to the cloud; without labels it falls back to Local.
settings.scope_note_cloud: Every sampled frame is uploaded; the original video never leaves this machine.
settings.summary_note: Saved changes apply to the next run; existing files are not re-run.
settings.advanced_note: Changes apply to the next run; existing files are not re-run.
batch.title: Batch processing
batch.lede: Process {n} selected files · {size}. Originals are never modified.
batch.task_remux_desc: Change the container only; video is stream-copied, lossless and fastest.
batch.task_compress_desc: Re-encode for a smaller file; CPU, NVIDIA NVENC or AMD AMF.
batch.task_custom_desc: Edit an ffmpeg template, copy it, or save a .bat file.
batch.pane_lede: These options are remembered for the next batch.
batch.quality_hint: Lower values mean higher quality and larger files.
batch.folder_hint: All outputs go into this one folder
batch.overwrite_hint: Overwrite writes a temp file first and replaces only on success; sources are still protected.
batch.adv_summary: Audio, subtitles, encoder preset, failure policy
batch.fallback: Fall back to CPU if hardware encoding fails
batch.custom_adv_note: Audio, subtitles, chapters and encoder settings all come from your template; the app adds nothing.
batch.template_hint: {input} and {output} are replaced with real paths.
batch.template_empty: The custom command template is empty. Fill in {input} and {output}.
batch.safety: Writes a temp file first; output paths equal to an input are blocked.
batch.safety_custom: Custom commands run as written; test a small batch first.
batch.note_nvenc: NVIDIA hardware encoding: fast and light on the CPU.
batch.note_amf: AMD hardware encoding: fast and light on the CPU.
batch.note_cpu: No usable hardware encoder was found; CPU encoding will be slower.
batch.note_remux: Video is stream-copied, not re-encoded; audio and subtitles follow the compatibility policy.
batch.note_custom: Commands run exactly as written; custom mode does not pre-check codec compatibility.
batch.compat_mp4: MP4 is the safest container; text subtitles become mov_text.
batch.compat_mkv: MKV accepts almost anything; subtitles, chapters and attachments are kept.
batch.compat_mov: MOV is widely compatible; text subtitles become mov_text.
batch.compat_m4v: M4V is an Apple container; H.264/H.265 with AAC is safest.
batch.compat_webm: WebM suits VP8/VP9/AV1 sources; use MKV for anything else.
batch.compat_avi: AVI is legacy; modern subtitles are dropped.
batch.compat_flv: FLV works best with H.264 + AAC; other combinations may fail.
batch.compat_other: Audio and video are remuxed into the chosen container.
batch.check_custom_overwrite: Overwrite mode: matching files are replaced
batch.check_container_incompat: This container may drop some tracks
batch.preview_note: Shows final paths; at run time a temp file is written first and replaced on success.
batch.msg_no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg was not found. Install it or add it to PATH.
batch.msg_nothing_to_do: Nothing to process — every file may have been skipped.
batch.confirm_overwrite: {n} output files already exist and overwriting cannot be undone. Continue?
batch.summary_fallback_sub: {n} files processed (some fell back to CPU)
